# Jubilees Chapter 10 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Demons Released; Mastema's Petition; Noah's Medical Book; Tower of Babel

---

**10:1** In the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of Noah's sons, causing them to err and bringing destruction upon them.

**10:2** The sons of Noah came to their father Noah and told him about the demons that were leading astray, blinding, and killing his grandsons.

**10:3** Noah prayed before the LORD his God and said: "God of the spirits of all flesh, you showed mercy to me and saved me and my sons from the waters of the flood, and did not let me perish as you did the children of destruction. Your grace toward me has been great, and your mercy toward my soul has been abundant. Let your grace be lifted up over my sons, and do not let evil spirits rule over them to destroy them from the earth."

**10:4** "But bless me and my sons, that we may increase and multiply and fill the earth."

**10:5** "You know how your Watchers, the fathers of these spirits, acted in my day. As for these spirits which are living — imprison them and hold them fast in the place of condemnation, and do not let them bring destruction on the sons of your servant, my God; for they are malicious and were created to destroy."

**10:6** "Let them not rule over the spirits of the living; for you alone can exercise dominion over them. Let them have no power over the righteous from this time and forever."

**10:7** The LORD our God commanded us to bind all of them.

**10:8** Then the chief of the spirits, Mastema, came forward and said: "LORD, Creator, leave some of them in my presence; let them hear my voice and do all that I command them. For if none are left to me, I will be unable to execute my power of will over the sons of men. For these are for corruption and for leading astray before my judgment, because great is the wickedness of the sons of men."

**10:9** And God said: "Let a tenth of them remain before him, and let the nine parts descend into the place of condemnation."

**10:10** One of us he commanded to teach Noah all their remedies, for he knew that they would not walk in uprightness nor strive in righteousness.

**10:11** We did according to all his words: all the malicious evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth of them we left to be subject before Satan on the earth.

**10:12** We explained to Noah all the remedies for their diseases, together with their enticements, how to heal them with herbs of the earth. Noah wrote down everything in a book as we instructed him — every kind of medicine. Thus the evil spirits were prevented from harming the sons of Noah.

**10:13** He gave everything he had written to Shem his eldest son, for he loved him exceedingly above all his sons.

**10:14** Noah slept with his fathers and was buried on Mount Lubar in the land of Ararat.

**10:15** He lived nine hundred and fifty years — nineteen jubilees and two weeks and five years.

**10:16** In his life on earth he was more righteous and upright than any other person, save Enoch; for Enoch was assigned to recount the testimony of the world, but Noah was righteous, blameless, and perfect in all his ways.

**10:17** In the thirty-third jubilee, in the first year of the second week, Peleg took a wife named Lomna, daughter of Sina'ar, and she bore him a son in the fourth year of that week. He named him Reu, saying: "Behold, the children of men have become evil through wicked purpose and evil works." And in his days they built the tower, saying: "Let us go up through it into heaven."

**10:18** They began to build, and in the fourth week they abandoned it. In those days they had built it to three hundred and forty-three cubits height, and its summit reached into the sky and was visible from far away. All the peoples dwelling on the earth had stopped building their cities and their works.

**10:19** The prince Mastema desired to accomplish all of this, and he sent other spirits — those under his command — to tell the children of men to build the city and the tower.

**10:20** "Let us ascend through it into heaven," they said. For in those days Naram was appointed as ruler; he ruled and was powerful.

**10:21** The LORD our God descended to see the city and the tower which the children of men had built.

**10:22** He confounded their languages, and they could no longer understand one another's speech, and they ceased to build the city and the tower.

**10:23** For this reason the whole land of Shinar is called Babel, because the LORD there confounded all the languages of the children of men, and from there they were dispersed into their cities, each according to his language and his nation.

**10:24** The LORD sent a mighty wind against the tower and overthrew it onto the earth. It lay between Asshur and Babylon in the land of Shinar, and they called its name "Overthrow."

**10:25** In the fourth week, in the first year of its beginning, in the thirty-fourth jubilee, they were scattered from the land of Shinar.

**10:26** Ham and his sons went into the land which he had taken — which was not in their allotted portion — to the west, by the sea.

**10:27** And Canaan saw the land of Lebanon as far as the Jordan and the coast of the sea, and took it for himself.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows LOGOS throughout. "Mastema" (v.8) preserved as proper name — the Jubilees-specific adversarial figure. "Satan" (v.11) appears as the Ge'ez parallel term in the same verse; both preserved. Noah's medical book (v.12) rendered with full detail. Mastema's role in Tower of Babel (v.19) clearly flagged.*
